To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have measured the absolute efficiencies of a VUV and a soft X-ray spectroscopy system and that we have demonstrated the usefulness of the system for plasma diagnostics.
The relative efficiency of a space- and time resolving VUV and soft-X ray spectrographs has been measured at the Photon Factory, KEK, Tsukuba.

the efficiency curves of the VUV and soft-X-ray spectrographs are flat over the whole wavelength range of the spectrograph, and that the efficiency curves are almost identical for different points of irradiating the grating and for different polarization geometries.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and calibration of space-resolving soft X-ray and VUV spectrographs.
the calibration of the space-resolving soft X-ray and VUV spectrographs for plasma diagnosis.
the calibration of the new space-resolving VU V and soft X-ray spectrometers for plasma diagnostics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
both spectrographs have been calibrated with sufficient accuracy for the intended application in plasma diagnostics. (orig.) 11 refs., 7 figs., 1 tab.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a calibration procedure for the space-resolving VU V and soft X-ray spectrometers has been established.
the relative efficiencies of the two spectrographs are in agreement with the theory of diffraction by gratings.
the efficiency curves for the VUV and soft x-ray spectrographs have been obtained with sufficient accuracy to allow quantitative interpretation of the spectroscopic measurements.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the soft X-ray range, the relative efficiency of the spectrograph depends on the polarization of the incident radiation.

the efficiency of the VU V and soft X-ray gratings is strongly dependent on the groove direction and polarization geometry, but the relative efficiency can be determined to better than a few percent accuracy.
the calibration results are consistent with theoretical expectations.
